records.failureSummary:
Reviewed slice-4 (lifecycle and resilience, FR-4 / AC-16..AC-20) against the PRD contracts. Verdict: APPROVED, no blocking issues.

Contract checks (all pass):
1. data-testid names: every emitted name is one of the 21 PRD names and none is invented - app-title and loading-indicator (App.vue), error-banner and retry-button (ErrorBanner.vue), search-input and filter-all/filter-active/filter-done (TaskFilters.vue), task-count and new-task-button (TaskToolbar.vue), task-list/empty-state/no-results (TaskList.vue), task-item/task-title/task-done-toggle/task-delete-button (TaskItem.vue), new-task-dialog/task-title-input/form-error/save-task-button/cancel-task-button (NewTaskDialog.vue).
2. data-done: TaskItem binds :data-done=\"isDone ? 'true' : 'false'\" with isDone = task.done === true, so the attribute is always present and exactly \"true\"/\"false\" (no truthy coercion, no missing attribute).
3. Transport: fetch exists in exactly two modules, src/api/tasks.ts (store: GET list, PATCH, DELETE) and src/api/tasksApi.ts (create). Both build URLs from import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE read once at module scope (API_BASE strips trailing slashes), no file/config read at runtime, no hardcoded host or port in shipped code, PATCH sends JSON { done }, DELETE resolves only on 204 and rejects on 404/other. src/lint.mjs enforces no /__mock/ and no CDN references and passes. No frontend code calls /__mock/* (only the mock server, comment text, the lint rule and test assertions mention it).
4. task-count: App passes tasks.length (the unfiltered source array) to TaskToolbar, which renders it as a bare number; search/filter never change it, store.deleteTask removes by id from the source array after a 204, so the count decrements by exactly one, and a 404/5xx leaves the row and the count untouched.
5. First-load 500 and retry: store.loadTasks sets loading, clears error, catches the rejection into error and always clears loading in finally; App renders ErrorBanner (with nested retry-button when error !== null) and hides the list while an error is set; retry() clears error, sets loading and re-enters the same plain /api/tasks load path, so a successful retry removes the banner and renders rows. Verified by tests that count exactly two GETs.
6. Console cleanliness: no console.error/console.log in application source (only in unused tooling scripts src/lint.mjs, src/start.mjs, src/typecheck.mjs, which are not imported by main.ts); every store action wraps its await in try/catch, TaskItem re-enables its own control in finally, and App uses void on actions that never reject. Tests spy on console.error plus process unhandledRejection and window unhandledrejection across load, first-load 500, retry, toggle, rejected PATCH, rejected DELETE and delete success.
7. Unchanged inputs: package.json differs only in the lint and test scripts (dependencies/devDependencies untouched); pnpm-lock.yaml and mock-server.mjs are unmodified per git status.

AC coverage (each Must criterion has both tests and implementation):
AC-16: 12 AC-marked tests (lifecycle-integration 2, lifecycle-toggle 3, task-item-row 3, task-store 2, task-api-client 2) against TaskItem.vue, taskStore.toggleDone and api/tasks.ts patchTask.
AC-17: 5 AC-marked tests (lifecycle-integration 1, lifecycle-toggle 1, task-item-row 1, task-store 1, taskboard-container 1) against the PATCH + server-returned task reconciliation and the fresh-mount reload path.
AC-18: 16 AC-marked tests (lifecycle-delete 6, taskboard-container 2, task-store 2, task-item-row 2, task-api-client 3, lifecycle-integration 1) against api/tasks.ts deleteTask (204-only), taskStore.deleteTask and the source-length task-count.
AC-19: 14 AC-marked tests (lifecycle-error-retry 4, taskboard-container 3, task-store 3, task-api-client 2, lifecycle-integration 1, first-load-resilience 1) against ErrorBanner.vue, taskStore.loadTasks/retry and the App wiring.
AC-20: 16 AC-marked tests (lifecycle-console 8, lifecycle-integration 4, task-api-client 2, task-store 1, first-load-resilience 1) against the store try/catch blocks, TaskItem finally re-enable and the absence of console.error.

Verification run: npm run test => 22 files / 125 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, exit 0; npm run lint => exit 0 (38 files); npm run typecheck => exit 0. I did not rebuild dist or run the browser oracle (out of scope for a read-only review).
